title: Coefficient lifting for skew divided differences and triple Schubert coefficients
summary: Skew divided difference operators \(\partial_{w/v}\), introduced by Macdonald, play an important role in the study of Schubert polynomials and their structure constants. For permutations \(u,v,w\in S_n\), we show that the coefficient of each monomial \(\xx^α\) in \(\partial_{w/v}\SSch_u(\xx;\yy)\), where \(\SSch_u(\xx;\yy)\) is the double Schubert polynomial, is a single triple Schubert coefficient evaluated at \(\tb=0\), whose indices form an explicit lift of \((u,v,w)\) to \(S_{n+\absα}\).
